description: `pinned`'s own text scores into the "low" band, but a profile `routing: high` pin overrides that: meta.model becomes the "high" band's model, model_reason: "router", and meta.complexity.band is overwritten to the pinned row, not the scored one. `optout`'s text also scores into "low", but its profile `routing: false` opt-out leaves that score recorded without acting on it: meta.model stays the run default, model_reason: "default".
